QC-1_connectivity.detail: 17 main edges + 13 branch edges, all with from_node and to_node. One legitimate open end (N-018 continuation); dead-leg terminations at N-106, N-206, N-303.

QC-2_orphan_nodes.detail: No orphan flow nodes. N-019 (support) is deliberately not a flow node. N-017 is connected but identification is uncertain.

QC-3_component_count.detail: 27 visually identified components (excluding gaskets and bolt sets) vs 27 topology nodes of the same classes. 5 gaskets visually implied, 5 in topology, 5 in MTO.

QC-4_dimension.detail: Every main-run segment carries an explicit dimension. Straight-pipe values on E-009, E-014, E-015 are UNKNOWN pending the flange length-through-hub. No length estimated.

QC-5_size_continuity.detail: One run-size change (2->3 in at reducer N-004) and three run-to-branch changes (3->3/4 in at sockolets). No unexplained change.

QC-6_line_number_continuity.detail: Five line numbers in the line list; only the 3 in CC38MM number is annotated on the geometry. See A-06, U-008.

QC-7_flow_direction.detail: No flow arrow at the check valve or anywhere else. Direction inferred only. See U-001.

QC-8_branch_completeness.detail: Three branch connections visible, three in the topology. Sockolet MTO count (3) matches.

QC-9_route_completeness.detail: PATH-001 terminates at an equipment nozzle and at a coordinated continuation point. All branches terminate at a blind flange or an instrument.

QC-10_mto_reconciliation.detail: 19 of 19 MTO items match the topology. One drawn element (N-017) has no MTO entry. Topology was not altered to force agreement.

QC-11_coordinate_closure.detail: SOUTH run closes exactly (1090 mm). Vertical closes to 1 mm. Riser closes to 3 mm (0.2 mm with the gasket). EAST run 5 mm short.

QC-12_axis_consistency.detail: North arrow, isometric axes and stated E/N coordinates are mutually consistent and verified numerically.
